text:
Amelia Chen: Heads-up. Sales just handed us a big intake: NovaFin. They require VPC-only deployment, no public egress, HSM-managed keys with monthly rotation, and an internal-only image registry. Can we triage?

Sam Ortiz: Details from sales: Azure VNet peering, customer wants dedicated nodes in their subnet, no outbound allowed, and signed image artifacts only. Procurement wants a pilot in ~8 weeks.

Ravi Patel: Support ticket created: <link://zendesk/7981>. They attached a network diagram, compliance matrix, and vendor HSM spec.

Amelia Chen: Quick Qs for triage: timelines confirmed? blockers we should surface now? any legal/contract asks?

Jorge Alvarez: Infra notes: private peering + service endpoints, route approvals, and NAT/proxy egress through customer side. Registry must be internal-only; we need an image import flow (signed tarball or registry mirror).

Lisa Moore: Security/compliance: customer-managed KMS/HSM, audit logs required to their SIEM, and no callbacks to our hosted telemetry endpoints unless explicitly allowed. Also they want signed attestations for image provenance.

Sam Ortiz: Sales timeline again: pilot target 8w, production target 16w. Pilot is gating procurement approvals so it's high priority.

Amelia Chen: Proposed two-step delivery:
Phase 1 (validation pilot, ~8w): establish peering, manual signed-image transfer, ephemeral test keys, minimal telemetry via customer-approved collector.
Phase 2 (production, ~16w): full KMS/HSM adapter integration, automated monthly rotation, registry sync/mirroring, hardened runbooks and audit playbook.

Jorge Alvarez: Dependencies to track:
```
- Customer network approvals / peering (owner: customer)
- Image signing & import flow (owner: eng-platform)
- HSM vendor SDK + KMS adapter (owner: security)
- Airgap build/release runbook (owner: devex)
- Telemetry collector config without external callbacks (owner: observability)
- Legal attestation for data handling (owner: legal)
```

Ravi Patel: Added note: customer expects monthly governance calls and SOC docs. Add to onboarding checklist.

Lisa Moore: I'll draft a short threat-model + HSM security plan and handle security sign-off. Also we should confirm supported HSM vendors and whether they support remote rotation APIs.

Jorge Alvarez: Rough parallel estimates: peering coordination 1-2w, image import tool 2-3w, HSM adapter 4w, runbook + validation tests 1w. We can parallelize image tooling and HSM prep where possible.

Amelia Chen: Acceptance criteria for pilot (validation):
- Peering established and connectivity smoke-tested
- Instance(s) successfully pull and run signed image with no public egress
- Customer can run sample inference workload and validate results
- Health metrics visible only to customer via approved ingestion
- Signed attestation of image provenance delivered to customer

Sam Ortiz: I'll set customer expectations around phased plan and get confirmation on pilot date window.

Deploy Bot: new issue created: PRD-2429 (novafin-airgap-intake) by Amelia Chen

Amelia Chen: I'll create the backlog tickets and tag eng-platform, eng-infra, security, devex, and observability. Meeting to align tomorrow 11:00 PT — @Jorge Alvarez @Lisa Moore @Ravi Patel can you make it?

Jorge Alvarez: 11:00 PT works for me.

Lisa Moore: Fine here.

Ravi Patel: Yep, see you then. :thumbsup:
